record.tooling: rclone backend 'linkbox' (Tier 5, since v1.65; since v1.74 needs API token and email/password because listing/downloading moved to account auth)
record.chaining: If the edu/gov verification path still works, one verified identity yields 10 TB. That is 2000x the base tier, i.e. the largest single-account multiplier in this niche; otherwise 5 GB x unlimited accounts.
record.limits_note: free downloads throttled to under 1 MB/s; the site is a JS SPA (www.linkbox.to now serves a 'TeleBox' bundle) so quotas are not readable without executing JS; rclone backend is Tier 5, i.e. least-tested
record.reliability_note: origin times out repeatedly under a headless reader (504 deadline on /, /pricing, /admin/account), indicative of an unstable front end behind an automated-traffic filter; Tier 5 backend means frequent breakage

evidence.proved: backend exists, Tier 5, changed auth model in v1.74
